notes.title: Version 1.0.76 is Live
notes.notes:
The latest release of UDG is now live for all players.  We appreciate everyone's patience while we worked to upgrade the game build to Unreal Engine 4.26 in addition to everything else that was on the list for this release.

There are some major improvements to the dynamic weather system including the option to disable it completely and pick the weather for the round (we know this was a major pain for most players).

We're also very excited to announce that this release includes angling the disc hyzer or anhyzer.  This is a WIP and some flight physics still need further tuning to match up to different release angles but the mechanic is there and many more shot shapes are now possible.

Full Changelog:

Core update: Updated game build to Unreal Engine 4.26
Core update: Game now defaults to DirectX 12
Menu update - Various improvements and fixes for the Casual Round menu
Bugfix - Fixed Atom driver material
Adjustment - decreased sliding on Top Disc turf physical material
Adjustment - Moved dynamic Tee target to a better position above the tee area
Many improvements to weather system
Upgraded sky system - better performance overall, better looking, and prepared for volumetric clouds in next release.
New Feature - Angle of release :) *WIP*
New Animations - New backhand & putt animations based on AI mocap
New Feature - Inverse kinematics *WIP*
Bugfix / Improvement - Fixed celebration cinematics so they now work on all courses and can also now be skipped using the interact button.

Thank you so much to everyone that has stuck with UDG, and given us the chance to continue improving it.  Lot's more awesome stuff coming right around the corner so stay tuned.

UDG Discord: https://discord.com/invite/NrfjsX2

Cheers,
Joshua, Lead Dev.

notes.title: Next Release Is Almost Ready
notes.notes:
Just wanted to keep everyone up to date that we've been working hard over the last few weeks on the next release and it is just about ready.

Should be within the next couple of days.

As always we welcome anyone to join the UDG Discord to interact with us directly to leave feedback, suggestions, etc.  We also regularly post behind the scenes stuff on Discord as well for those that want to keep up with the latest developments in-between releases. - https://discordapp.com/invite/NrfjsX2

Thanks to all of you for playing, now back to work for us...

notes.title: Hot-fix Patch for 1.0.74
notes.notes:
We greatly appreciate all of the great suggestions and bug reports on Discord since the last release, it greatly helped us get this hot-fix release done quickly.  Progress continues on the remaining major features for alpha such as angle of release and this patch is mainly a hot-fix for minor bugs.

Patch Changelog:


 Bugfix: added check to prevent starting a hole from the wrong tee
 Bugfix: added check to prevent getting credit for the wrong hole if a disc lands in the wrong basket.
 Bugfix / Enhancement: Landing a disc on top of basket triggers auto tap-in
 Enhancement: Cleaned up more camera work
 Bugfix: Fixed issue where character body mesh was invisible on low graphics settings
 Minor Change: Unlocked camera movement when targeting the next tee or basket using the targeting system.
 Enhancement: Added base air resistance which causes discs to wiggle up and down a bit vertically to give more realistic flight.  (WIP)  This will be further enhanced with the upcoming wind system.
 Bugfix: With the release of 1.0.74 the score widget had a bug that would show multiple scores when finishing a hole that was a lower par than the next.  This bug should be fixed and only the appropriate score designation should pop up. Ace, eagle, etc.
 Bugfix: Ace stat now correctly shows on stats pages


Stay tuned for info about the upcoming UDG competitive game-night where we'll be streaming the game with some players from the community who also stream and hanging out together in one of the Voice channels on Discord.  Should be a fun time and we welcome anyone to join even if you don't want to stream.

As always we're available on the UDG Discord for anyone that has suggestions, feedback, or questions.

Happy Holidays from the TREE family to yours!

notes.title: v1.0.73 Minor Release Is Now Live
notes.notes:
1.0.73 Alpha

1) Bugfix - disable teleporting after starting a hole to prevent bug that caused player to temporarily be stuck in tee
2) Bugfix - Prevent un-equipping discs using quick slot selection once throw sequence has been started which caused round ending bug
3) Improvement - Finished hole par setup on Whispering Bluffs
4) Improvement - Added default clothing to character creator
5) Bugfix - when teleporting if you are crouched it will now automatically stand you up after the teleport.
6) Bugfix - remove M key that was in use for testing step outs

There are also some other minor tweaks and fixes.  Work continues to finalize angle of release mechanics, and soon we'll be ready to patch in the first set of challenges, missions, and progression system.

A huge thank you to the community for all of the suggestions, bug reports, etc.  If you haven't already make sure to join the UDG Discord which is the easiest way to interact with the dev. team if you have any input or feedback about the game.

https://discord.com/invite/NrfjsX2

notes.title: Halloween Patch
notes.notes:
The holiday season is upon us, and for most of us it has been a bumpy road through 2020 to say the least.  So while lot's of great progress is happening on the remaining core game-play features, we wanted to change things up and have some fun to get in the Halloween spirit.

Sunny Birch has gotten a bit of a make-over and has been transformed into "Spooky Birch".  This Halloween themed course will be playable through the end of the month.

While this isn't an official release we did squeeze in a couple of other small patches.


 Targeting system now works with Tees and Baskets
 Day/Night cycle has been set to 3 hours each
 Further tweaked night-time lighting on several courses
 Fine-tuned sun hazard on Dusty Canyon
 Changed sun angle on Dusty Canyon so morning rounds to not start first hole with sun hazard anymore

notes.title: Version 1.0.72 is now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.72 is now live for all Steam players.  We're very excited to have Steam stats now working (more to be added soon).  Leader-boards are now also being tested out and will be polished over the next couple of releases..

Chestnut Lakes had some holes that were very difficult with the current throw power.  We will soon be finalizing the player ability system which will make it possible to increase throw power, accuracy, etc.  In the meantime we have added safer shot placement options on Chestnut Lakes making it playable with base throw power.

Please welcome the new course "Whispering Bluffs" to the game.  An 18 hole course with sweeping views and challenging par 4 and 5 holes.

[previewyoutube=U0NMZgzolDg;full][/previewyoutube]

1) Improvements: Chestnut Lakes improvements giving more shot placement options across water hazards
2) Bugfix / Enhancement: Fixed and improved water hazard mechanic and FX
3) New Feature: Implemented lean out mechanic
4) New Feature: Steam stats are activated
5) New Feature: Implemented basket targeting mechanic
6) Enhancement: New physically based unified water system with realistic ripples, caustics, particles etc
7) Enhancement: Feminine posture and locomotion for female custom characters
8) Enhancement: Hole previews can now be triggered for the hole in play even when not standing on the tee pad.
9) Disabled SteamVR until full VR support is ready.
10) Enhancement: Added an additional camera rotation mode that allows for a full 360 deg. view of the player.
11) Bugfix: Fixed hole scoring on Par 4 or greater holes
12) Bugfix: Upgrade from UE4.22 to 4.24 cleared out the default RHI config.  We believe this is what was causing the random crash on startup to happen.  The game will now default to DirectX11 as it did before the Unreal Engine update which caused the random crashes to start.
13) Enhancement: Steam leaderboards! (rough version still a WIP)
14) New Course!: "Whispering Bluffs"

The next major release will contain the long-awaited arrival of being able to change release angles!  Before that we plan to have a smaller release or two with mostly bug-fixes.

A special thank you to everyone that has submitted suggestions, bug reports, and other feedback!

notes.title: Ultimate Disc Golf Version 1.0.7 Is Live
notes.notes:
This next major release of Ultimate Disc Golf is now live for all Steam players.  We appreciate everyone's patience as we worked to upgrade the game from Unreal Engine 4.22 to 4.24 for this release.

Many things have been improved / overhauled including but not limited to:

Animation / character locomotion system
Menu system
Character creation system
Throwing mechanics

There is still much to do, but we are extremely excited about this release as it marks a solid step in the right direction for the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Releasing Soon
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the last release, but there is a good reason why.  The game was recently upgraded to use Unreal Engine 4.24 which opened up a lot of new features under the hood.  This decision was not made lightly, but the team felt it was better to do it now while still in alpha and waiting until later would only make the process more time consuming.

Upgrading is looking like the right decision, since the last release 1.0.6 we have been able to improve / overhaul several major things such as the custom character creation, locomotion system, and the entire menu system.  This meant a longer wait between releases than the 1-2 week release cycle we had been consistent with.

Check out these videos of some updates that will be a part of the next release.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Is Live
notes.notes:
The next release of Ultimate Disc Golf (1.0.5) is now live. It includes several additions and enhancements such as an inventory system, and 9 total discs to choose from :).

For those just curious about the game and have not purchased through early access we invite you to try it free when it becomes available through our Itch.io page in about 24-32 hours.

1.0.5 Changelog:

1) Enhancement: Added inventory system!
2) Enhancement: Polished camera effects for celebration cinematic
3) Enhancement: Added contextual hints that can be turned on or off through the game settings and will work on any level (more hints still need to be added).  This should greatly improve the experience for first-time players.
3) Enhancement: Added several new discs that now include stable and under-stable
4) Bugfix: Dusty canyon will now correctly use the "time of day" setting in single player mode.
5) Bugfix: changing resolution in game settings should be working properly now
6) Addition: Base putter model has been completed and is now being used for all putters in the game.
7) Enhancement: The thicker bushes now use a CameraDepthFade that will fade their leaves out when close to the camera making much easier to recover a disc and throw from within the bushes.
8) Testing first "fancy" inventory icons for discs
9) Bugfix: Holding the aim button before starting the next throw would result in the trajectory and power meter not triggering.  Equipping a disc while holding the aim button first is now prevented by an internal check and a contextual message has been added. 
10) Enhancement: It's now possible to enable or disable the mini-map through the game settings.  This should give a decent performance boost on lower end hardware
11) Bugfix: Basket chains now have a more realistic "sway" and also won't become possessed.  Hitting the chains with your character repeatedly can still cause a slight visual bug but not nearly as bad.
12) Performance: removed tesselation from landscape on Breezy Pines

notes.title: What coming up in version 1.0.5
notes.notes:
The inventory system we've been working on under the hood for quite some time is getting close to being ready for testing.  With the inventory system update we'll also be releasing more discs.

The current discs would probably be considered a bit over-stable when thrown flat, so next we'll be adding at least one stable, and under-stable driver, mid-range, and putter.

We've also been listening closely to new players who may not be avid disc-golfers, and as such want better in-game hints / tutorial.  Our team has been hard at word putting this towards the top of our list and have setup a full game settings based hints system within UDG.

These hints can be turned on or off from the settings menu and will work on any course during single player mode.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 is Live
notes.notes:
We are very thankful for every person who has taken part in purchasing UDG through Early Access.  Our team is working hard to release an update every 1-2 weeks throughout alpha and most of beta.  Version 1.0.4 is now live for all Early Access players, please find the full change-log below.

1) Added variations and power check for female "throw effort" soundfx
2) Added first Steam achievement
3) Physics: Fine tuned flight physics when throwing a high angle throw.  Discs will now not keep carrying forever after turning and will eventually fade out more realistically.
4) Fix scoreboards to show correct stroke count
5) Removed "Account" button on main menu (not needed currently)
6) Activated first 9 hole course for Dusty Canyon!
7) Activated MP Steam lobbies (P2P only) for testing (gameplay is not functional yet)
8) Bugfix: Sunny Birch hole #2 preview is fixed
9) Distance to hole in player UI is now dynamic and will change after each throw showing the current distance to the basket

Though we still have a lot of work to do, especially when it comes to improving the experience for new players who have not followed us or have much knowledge of the sport.  Our goal in the end is for those players who had a hard time acclimating to the game in it's current state can eventually have an easier time getting started.  For those that are already enjoying it, we appreciate all of the positive feedback and seeing your reactions on video and streams is only adding to our motivation to continue improving the game.  Check out this video below of Disc Golf Comedy bagging an ace (roughly 37 minutes in), his reaction is something that hits at the heart of what our team is trying to achieve with Ultimate Disc Golf.
